concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-reconciliation-use-cases-build-transactional-ledger]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Classic account-level accounting-ledger guide for split/liable rows, fees, balance comparison and aged-negative-balance compensation.
warnings: Missing split instructions can book to the liable account; all transaction fees are deducted there. A negative balance after refunds/chargebacks can transfer to the liable account at month end after more than 30 days. Selected rows and Payout records do not prove bank receipt.
